title: tpu-vm-vllm vars
description: Variables for Cloud TPU VM vLLM AI model serving stack

TPU_NAME.description: Name of the TPU VM instance serving the model

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID where the TPU VM is provisioned

TPU_ZONE.description: Google Cloud Zone for the TPU VM (e.g. us-central2-b)

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: TPU accelerator version and topology (e.g. v4-8)

MODEL_NAME.description: Hugging Face or GCS model identifier served by vLLM

PORT.description: HTTP port on which vLLM exposes its OpenAI-compatible API
